serverInfo.name: invinoveritas
serverInfo.description: Verification layer for autonomous agents — signed pre-action verdicts, recomputable proofs, and a public audit ledger. Free /verify-proof; /review has free try-it calls, then pay-per-use. After a payment: free /verify-execution (was it the payment the verdict bound?) and the free payment_receipt tool (POST /payment-receipt): a signed receipt with retry_state and an idempotency key, so a retry cannot double-pay.
